tour.title: Project Entry
tour.description: Start with the project overview and current-state documents to understand the v2 branch, its goals, and the remaining legacy surface.

tour.title: Desktop Shell
tour.description: Move into the Flet entry point and calendar view builder to see how the desktop UI still orchestrates much of the runtime behavior.

tour.title: Service Layer
tour.description: Review the service modules that now own task, note, calendar, export, and backup workflows on top of PostgreSQL.

tour.title: Import Pipeline
tour.description: Follow the versioned calendar import path from parsers through the import service into calendar source snapshots.

tour.title: Data Model
tour.description: Inspect the authoritative PostgreSQL schema and database helper layer that underpin the v2 application services.

tour.title: Migration And Verification
tour.description: Finish with the migration scripts and test suite to understand how v1 data is moved forward and how the service layer is validated.
